Katherine Katche (also known as Ekaterina Alexeevna
Orlovskaya Katche), actress 30 years old, arrived in Shanghai
from Colombo on 31 May by the s.s. "Felix Roussel", which
sailed from that port on 17th May, 1937.
Katherine Katche (nee Orlovskaya) was born in
Vladivostock and became a naturalized Lithuanian on her
marriage to Valentine Katche. She is in possession of
Lithuanian passport No. 38 Serial O.B./43337 issued at Harbin
on 23 July 1926.
Her husband, Valentine Katche, age 37, Actor, arrived
in Shanghai by the s.s. "Haruna Maru" at 2 a.m. on 8th June
1937. He is a Lithuanian subject born in Kaunas (Kovno),
Lithuania 37 years ago and is in possession of Lithuanian
passport No. 37 Serial 43336 issued at Harbin on 8th February
1936. His passport declaration form states that the object
of his trip is theatrical work; the duration of his stay in
China will be about one year, and that P.S. Grigorieff,
proprietor of Grigorieff Ltd., - 860-864 Avenue Joffre, is
known to him. On the "Haruna Maru" passenger list his
forwarding address is recorded as c/o Shanghai Zaria, 777
Avenue Joffre (correct No. is 774).
At 7 a.m. June 8th he was met at the Whangpoo Wharf
by his wife who was accompanied by another female subsequently
ascertained to be Mrs. Elena I. Rozenzveig, age 46, born in
Irkutsk Siberia, who is in possession of U.S.S.R. passport
No. 075740 issued at Harbin on 1st March 1935 and who arrived
in Shanghai from Dairen by the s.s. "Dairen Maru" on 30
October 1935. She is stated to be a domestic with intention
of sojourning permanently in Shanghai. Since her arrival

and are well known to the local theatre going community by
the stage pseudonym of Valin & Orlovsky: they have appeared
many times in Shanghai at the Lyceum Theatre and elsewhere -

time later and as a result they were taken to Police Headquarters

向所有愿意前往苏联俄罗斯的艺术家提供丰厚的聘用合同。瓦林·卡切（Valin Katche）及其妻子拒绝了这一提议，并立即离开哈尔滨前往上海，于1935年4月5日乘坐“青岛丸”号抵达。他们自该日起留在上海，直到1936年11月28日，他们与由迪米特里·达尼洛维奇·福基恩（Dimitry Danielovitch Fokien）管理、尼古拉斯·弗拉基米罗维奇·特梅舍夫王子（Prince Nicolas Vladiverovitch Temysheff）赞助的大型剧团一起，乘坐“孔特·罗索”号（s.s. "Conte Rosso"）轮船前往科伦坡，开始对印度和荷属东印度群岛的巡回演出。值得注意的是，该剧团中两名据称为苏联公民的成员被荷兰总领事拒发签证。在印度巡演期间，剧团访问了科伦坡、孟买和加尔各答等地。在加尔各答期间，卡切夫妇与其他艺术家之间发生了一些意见分歧，导致前者返回科伦坡，而剧团其余成员则留在加尔各答直到5月初，随后也返回科伦坡。
卡切夫妇在科伦坡一同登上“费利克斯·鲁塞尔”号轮船前往上海，卡切夫人直接随该船抵达上海，而卡切先生则在新加坡停留，一周后乘坐“春阳丸”号随后抵达。

THE CHINA PRESS, TUESDAY, MARCH 9, 1937

RUSSIAN SINGER
MAKES DEAL WITH
COUNT TENISHEFF

The lawsuit in the 2nd Special
District Court involving Mr. A.
Vertinsky, prominent Russian Singer
of ballads, and his former manager,
Count Nicholas Tenisheff, was
brought to an end yesterday morn-
ing.
Count Tenisheff brought suit
against the artist some time ago
for $468. Of this figure, the plaintiff
asked for $300 damages for breach
of contract and $168 in back salary.
The matter came up in court and
Mr. Vertinsky, through his attorney,
refused settlement. The contract
with the Count had been broken,
it was stated, because the latter
had made some blunders, causing
harm to Vertinsky. This was denied.
When the case came up yester-
day, the court advised the two
parties to settle their differences
without a trial. Vertinsky's attor-
ney offered the Count $125 in full
settlement. It was accepted. Pay-
ment is to be made in two install-
ments, one on April 1 and the other
on April 15.

《字林西报》，1937年3月9日，星期二

俄国歌手
与特尼舍夫伯爵
达成和解

涉及著名俄国民谣歌手 A. 韦尔京斯基（A. Vertinsky）先生与其前经理人尼古拉斯·特尼舍夫伯爵（Count Nicholas Tenisheff）的第二特区法院诉讼案，于昨日上午终结。
特尼舍夫伯爵此前不久对该艺术家提起诉讼，索赔468美元。其中，原告要求赔偿违约损失300美元，以及欠薪168美元。此事开庭审理，韦尔京斯基先生通过其律师拒绝和解。据称，与伯爵的合同之所以破裂，是因为后者犯了一些错误，给韦尔京斯基造成了损害。这一点遭到否认。
昨日案件开庭时，法院建议双方不经审判自行解决分歧。韦尔京斯基的律师向伯爵提出支付125美元作为全额和解金。该提议被接受。款项将分两期支付，一期于4月1日支付，另一期于4月15日支付。

Prince Nicolay Vladimirovitch Tennysheff, Russian, was born in 1895 at Alatir, Simbirsk Province. He received his education in Alatir Normal School and subsequently studied in the Technological Institute at Leningrad. In November 1930 he fled from the U.S.S.R. to Manchuria. He resided in Harbin and studied in the Y.M.C.A. School for Auto-mechanics. On 29.8.31 he arrived in Shanghai from Harbin via Tientsin. In Shanghai he has been engaged in business in the capacity of manager to various theatrical enterprises. He resides at No. 713 Avenue Joffre.

Prince N. V. Tennysheff is registered with the Russian Emigrants Committee.

Miss Nina Petrovna Glazit (stage name Moskvin ), Russian, was born on August 12, 1908, at Shanghai. Her father, who was a mechanic in the employ of the Russian Mercantile Fleet, perished during the Great War. In 1914 N. P. Glazit together with her mother left for Blagoveschensk, Siberia, where they resided with their relatives. Some time later her mother married a Russian named Borsch who owned a fishery concern. In 1921 N. P. Glasit together with her mother left for Sahalian, Manchuria, and subsequently proceeded to Harbin where she attended a ballet school. In 1926 she became a common law wife of one S. G. Davidovitch, Russian of Jewish origin, a fur merchant by occupation. Miss Glazit was mentioned in Davidovitch's Chinese passport as his wife under the name of Mrs. N. P. Davidovitch-Moskvin. Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Prince Nicolas

Boppe, is trying to form a group of dancers for engagement
at HELLENDOORN's at Soerabaia.

Dimitry Danielovitch FOKIEN, Russian
Larissa Vasilievna KRAVCHENKO, Russian
Valentin Eugenievitch VALIN KATCHE, Latvian
Ekaterina Alexeevna ORLOVSKAIA KATCHE, Latvian
Valentina Benedettvona FERETTI, Italian
Xenia Nikolaevna ERMOLAEVNA (Garetta), Russian

I have informed Prince Tennysheff that no visé will be
issued by me to Nina Vsevoladovna KOJEVNIKOVA and Eugenil
Alexandrovitch MUNZEV, who appear to be soviet citizens.

As soon as I receive the names of the other artists
whom Prince Tennysheff wants to engage, I shall not fail to
inform you thereof.

could let me know whether anything is known from a political
